title: 第八章 驰援孙坚
slug: 重生之战神吕布全本免费-重生之战神吕布最新章节列表
content_zh:
“卑职愿往。”部将胡轸出列道。
“好，胡将军乃是我军猛将，若是斩杀此僚，本将军会在相国面前为你请功。”华雄大笑道。
“多谢将军。”胡轸兴奋的拿起士卒递来的长刀，翻身上马。
见胡轸迎战，程普也不答话，飞马挺矛，直取胡轸，方交手不过三合，胡轸心中叫苦不已，对方的实力强过自己太多，他只能顽强的支撑着。
程普见急切间不能拿下胡轸，卖了个破绽，胡轸面露喜色，长刀直取程普胸膛，程普闪身躲过，大喊一声，一矛刺中胡轸喉咙。
华雄见程普勇猛，心中微惊，胡轸的实力在西凉军中是不弱的。
孙坚见程普将胡轸斩杀，古锭刀一挥，大军杀至关前，跟随胡轸出战的两千兵马，急忙逃向关内。
冲杀一阵，孙坚见关门紧闭，城上箭矢如雨，且攻城器械没有运来，引兵回梁东屯驻扎，待攻城器械一到，便攻打汜水关。
首战得胜，孙坚十分高兴，清君侧诛叛逆，可是不世之功，若是攻破汜水关，他这个先锋大将就能名震天下。
“主公，营中粮草仅够今日之需，而粮草还没有运过来。”程普清点粮草之后，急忙求见孙坚。
“立即命人前往袁公路处查看，粮草之事不容有失。”刚刚得到一场胜利，孙坚却是高兴不起来，粮草乃是大军根本。
“诺。”程普领命急匆匆而去。
且说吕布在营中无事，便在诸侯营中走动，有着对抗逆贼董卓的名声在那摆着，与诸侯之间倒也是很容易拉近关系，与历史上的名将称兄道弟，不亦乐乎。
不过他发现诸侯之中，除了公孙瓒、马腾、曹操与自己相谈甚欢之外，其余诸侯的态度有些冷淡，隐隐有些排斥。
“将军，探马来报，孙坚军已经没有粮草，不知为何，袁术迟迟不肯发粮，据说孙坚派来催粮的人也被他扣押了起来。”曹性低声说道。
“哼，目光短浅的小人。”吕布对袁术那是相当的看不起，仗着家世，在联军中胡作非为，早晚有一天会自食恶果。
“曹性，立即点齐两千骑兵，随本将军前去救援孙将军。”吕布沉思片刻命令道。
“诺。”曹性抱拳道。
“将军，孙坚与我军无旧，且日前提醒他时还惹得他不厌烦，为何要前去救援？”高顺十分惊讶吕布能够提前知道孙坚缺粮。
“孙文台乃是虎将，同为讨董大军，岂能坐看盟友受难，且我军在联军中人数较少，结交其他诸侯，也是防止袁家兄弟为难我等，尤其是袁公路，小人心肠，不得不防啊。”

听了吕布的解释，高顺抱拳道：“将军高见。”
“什么时候你也学会拍马屁了。”吕布笑道。
“卑职说的是心里话，将军能够提前得知孙坚少粮的消息，可见对袁术十分了解。”
“高将军，我与曹将军率领骑兵前往汜水关救援孙将军，你暂领全军事务，如有情况，自行处置。”
“诺。”高顺朗声道，自从吕布骑马受伤之后，他发现吕布变了很多，关心士卒，学会为他人考虑，他将这一切归功于丁刺史的死所带来的。
且说孙坚缺粮的消息为汜水关内华雄得知，在李肃的谋划下，华雄当夜兵分两路，出关杀向孙坚营寨。
正为粮草之事担心的孙坚没有料到华雄会袭营，再加上士卒经过数场战斗之后没有充足的粮草，军心不稳，一时军中大乱，人马践踏，死伤无数。
“袁术小儿误我。”孙坚大骂道。
“将军，华雄就要杀来，快走。”程普组织人马抵御敌军，眼前就要被西凉军冲破阵型。
“将军，速走。”祖茂带领一队人马杀来，急道。
“公覆，你们先走。”看着麾下人马乱作一团，兵不知将，孙坚虎目含泪，没想到大军却是败在没有粮草上，这让他如何向将士们交代。
“将军不可，留得有用之躯方能为我等报仇。”程普满脸是血。
“我们走。”孙坚咬牙道，大是大非面前，他选择了撤退。
华雄听从李肃的建议，在营寨中四处放火，再加上西凉军骑兵的冲击，使得孙坚军很快出现了溃败。
“孙坚，哪里逃。”华雄遥遥看到祖茂带领一队人马保护孙坚向外突围，大喝道。
孙坚手中古锭刀一挥，怒骂道：“无耻小儿，看本将军取你性命。”

content_en:
"I am willing to take this humble position." Hu Zhen, the general of the Ministry, came out of the queue.
"Okay, General Hu is a fierce general in our army. If you kill this officer, I will ask for credit for you in front of the Prime Minister." Hua Xiong laughed.
"Thank you, general." Hu Zhen excitedly picked up the long knife handed over by the soldier and got on his horse.
Seeing that Hu Zhen was fighting, Cheng Pu did not reply. He raised his flying horse and speared and attacked Hu Zhen, but Fang could not fight three times. Hu Zhen complained in his heart that the opponent's strength was much stronger than his own, so he could only hold on tenaciously.
Seeing that Cheng Pu couldn't take down Hu Zhen in his eagerness, he betrayed his flaw. Hu Zhen looked happy and pointed his sword directly at Cheng Pu's chest. Cheng Pu dodged and shouted, and stabbed Hu Zhen in the throat with his spear.
Hua Xiong was slightly shocked when he saw Cheng Pu's bravery. Hu Zhen's strength was not weak among the Xiliang army.
When Sun Jian saw Cheng Pu beheading Hu Zhen, he swung his ancient sword and the army reached the pass. The two thousand soldiers and horses who had followed Hu Zhen into the battle hurriedly fled into the pass.
After charging for a while, Sun Jian saw that the gate was tightly closed, arrows were raining on the city, and the siege equipment had not been delivered, so he led his troops back to Liangdongtun to station, and once the siege equipment arrived, he attacked Sishui Pass.
Sun Jian was very happy to win the first battle. The Qing emperor punished the rebels, but it was an unparalleled achievement. If he could break through the Sishui Pass, he, a pioneer general, would be famous all over the world.
"Lord, the food and grass in the camp are only enough for today's needs, but the food and grass have not been shipped yet." After Cheng Pu counted the food and grass, he hurriedly asked to see Sun Jian.
"Immediately order people to go to Yuan Highway to check. There is nothing wrong with the food and grass matter." Sun Jian had just won a victory, but he couldn't be happy. Food and grass are the foundation of an army.
"No." Cheng Pu took the order and hurried away.
Let's say that Lu Bu had nothing to do in the camp, so he walked around the camps of the princes. He had the reputation of fighting against the traitor Dong Zhuo, and it was easy to get close to the princes. It was a pleasure to call the famous generals in history brothers.
However, he found that among the princes, except for Gongsun Zan, Ma Teng, and Cao Cao, who had a happy conversation with him, the attitude of the other princes was a little cold and vaguely repulsive.
"General, I'm here to report that Sun Jian's army has no food and grass. For some reason, Yuan Shu has been reluctant to distribute food. It is said that the person Sun Jian sent to urge the food was also detained by him." Cao Xing said in a low voice.
"Huh, you are a short-sighted villain." Lu Bu looked down on Yuan Shu quite a lot. He acted recklessly in the coalition army based on his family background, and sooner or later he would suffer the consequences.
"Cao Xing, immediately order two thousand cavalry and follow me to rescue General Sun." Lu Bu thought for a moment and ordered.
"No." Cao Xing said, cupping his fists.
"General, Sun Jian has no history with our army, and I didn't annoy him when I reminded him a few days ago. Why did he go to rescue him?" Gao Shun was very surprised that Lu Bu knew in advance that Sun Jian was short of food.
"Sun Wentai is a tiger general, and he is also fighting against Dong's army. How can he just sit back and watch his allies suffer. Moreover, our army is relatively small in the coalition. Friendship with other princes is also to prevent the Yuan brothers from making things difficult for us, especially Yuan Gongdao, who has a villainous heart and has to be on guard."
After hearing Lu Bu's explanation, Gao Shun clasped his fists and said, "Goodbye, General."
"When did you learn to flatter me?" Lu Bu said with a smile.
"The humble position speaks from the heart. The general was able to learn about Sun Jian's lack of food in advance, which shows that he knows Yuan Shu very well."
"General Gao, General Cao and I will lead the cavalry to Sishui Pass to rescue General Sun. You are temporarily in charge of the affairs of the entire army. If there is any situation, you can handle it yourself."
"No." Gao Shun said loudly. Since Lu Bu was injured while riding, he found that Lu Bu had changed a lot. He cared about his soldiers and learned to consider others. He attributed all of this to the death of Governor Ding.
It is said that the news of Sun Jian's food shortage was learned by Hua Xiong in Sishui Pass. Under Li Su's plan, Hua Xiong divided his troops into two groups that night and went out to kill Sun Jian's camp.
Sun Jian, who was worried about food and grass, did not expect Hua Xiong to attack the camp. In addition, after several battles, the soldiers did not have enough food and grass, and the morale of the army was unstable.Trampled, numerous casualties.
"Young Yuan Shu mistook me," Sun Jian cursed.
"General, Hua Xiong is coming to kill, hurry up." Cheng Pu organized his troops to resist the enemy, but the Xiliang army was about to break through the formation in front of him.
"General, leave quickly." Zu Mao led a group of men and horses to attack and said urgently.
"Duke, you go first." Seeing his men and horses in chaos, and the soldiers not knowing their generals, Sun Jian had tears in his eyes. He didn't expect that the army was defeated because of lack of food and grass. How could he explain to the soldiers.
"General, no, you can only use your body to avenge us." Cheng Pu's face was covered with blood.
"Let's go." Sun Jian gritted his teeth and said. Faced with the big issue of right and wrong, he chose to retreat.
Hua Xiong followed Li Su's advice and set fires everywhere in the camp. Coupled with the attack of the Xiliang Army's cavalry, Sun Jian's army was quickly defeated.
"Sun Jian, where are you escaping?" Hua Xiong shouted from a distance when he saw Zu Mao leading a group of troops to protect Sun Jian and break out.
Sun Jian waved the ancient ingot sword in his hand and cursed angrily: "Shameless boy, let me take your life."
